correctness.rationale: The proof reduces any nonsquare-free mixed-prime cyclic order n=p^alpha m to two incomparable subgroups C_{p^t} and C_{p^{t-1}m}. A Bertrand-prime choice makes lower common neighbors impossible; the inequality alpha<3t-2 makes upper common neighbors impossible. The converse follows from coprime multiplicativity. Exact finite replay checks representative and exhaustive small cases.
